variants.text: The bar is on this side of the door and it has been chewed rather than cut. Whatever is down there put it up itself, and has kept it up, and would rather you came dressed.
Hesper's list has eight lines on it. Three are struck through in red and the red is not old. She did not strike them through herself.
You have walked past this door before, in an act of your life that is over now, and it was a cellar door then.
